description: Accept, decline or unlink a credit another filmmaker gave the user (credit_id from list_my_credits). Accepting a pending credit shows the film on the user's public profile; declining a pending one or unlinking an accepted one keeps the name on the film but removes the link to the user's account.

action.description: accept a pending credit; decline a pending one or unlink an accepted one (the name stays on the film, the link to your account goes).

name: respond_to_credit
title: Answer a credit
